payload.description: React Native drag and reorder operations need a non-drag path selected for the active native runtime
payload.do: Provide named Move up/down buttons or a position menu beside drag handles; route iOS and Android behavior through the runtime platform adapter
payload.dont: Make drag, swipe, or a web-only pointer handler the only way to reorder native content
payload.keywords: accessible drag interaction drag single pointer alternative keyboard drag alternative reorder resize move buttons React Native native runtime platform router arbitration iOS Android web
